FUNCTION N_QUEENS ACCEPTS(N)
  board <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 0 TO N-1
    board[i] <- EMPTY LIST
    FOR j FROM 0 TO N-1
      board[i][j] = 0
    END FOR
  END FOR
  FUNCTION IS_SAFE ACCEPTS(row, col)
    FOR i FROM 0 TO row-1
      IF board[i][col] == 1 THEN
        RETURN FALSE
      END IF
      IF col - (row - i) >= 0 AND board[i][col - (row - i)] == 1 THEN
        RETURN FALSE
      END IF
      IF col + (row - i) < N AND board[i][col + (row - i)] == 1 THEN
        RETURN FALSE
      END IF
    END FOR
    RETURN TRUE
  END FUNCTION
  FUNCTION PLACE_QUEENS ACCEPTS(row)
    IF row == N THEN
      RETURN TRUE
    END IF
    FOR col FROM 0 TO N-1
      IF IS_SAFE(row, col) THEN
        board[row][col] = 1
        IF PLACE_QUEENS(row + 1) THEN
          RETURN TRUE
        END IF
        board[row][col] = 0
      END IF
    END FOR
    RETURN FALSE
  END FUNCTION
  IF PLACE_QUEENS(0) THEN
    RETURN board
  ELSE
    RETURN NULL
  END IF
END FUNCTION
